name: W. Zeng
evidence: Resolved the row to Winnie Zeng, third author of 'Cross-Cultural Scenario Benchmark: Evaluating LLMs' Cross-Cultural Understanding', doi 10.3390/bdcc10090290 (GitHub: Erikiss/JournalWatch reports/2026-08-27.md lists 'Mengxi Guo, Leiming Gao, Winnie Zeng, et al.'), with The Hong Kong Polytechnic University as a likely affiliation - a 'Winnie Zeng - Hong Kong Polytechnic University' appears on a program-committee page in neusymbridge/neusymbridge.github.io, which is plausible but is only a name plus institution and carries no address. GitHub code search for 'Winnie Zeng' returned 26 hits otherwise dominated by clear namesakes: a Best Buy Capital investor on AngelList, a New Hampshire court case, a children's fantasy book series by Katie Zhao, and Bluesky account dumps. No address anywhere. The MDPI article page, which would print the corresponding author's address, is unreachable (www.mdpi.com, doi.org, crossref, openalex, europepmc all blocked by the egress policy). 'W. Zeng' is a very common abbreviated Chinese name, so nothing was accepted without a hard anchor.
